faq_heading: 2 bedroom townhomes in South Surrey: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a 2 bedroom townhome cost in South Surrey?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom townhomes in South Surrey, 101 sold over the past year at a median of $780,000, with the middle half between $699,000 and $927,000.

faq.q: How long does a 2 bedroom townhome take to sell in South Surrey?
faq.a: The median was 22 days, and homes sold for 97.4% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which South Surrey neighbourhood has the most 2 bedroom townhomes sales?
faq.a: Grandview, with 36 of the 101 sales at a median of $728,750.

faq.q: Which buildings in South Surrey have 2 bedroom townhomes for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: The Loop (8 sales, median $799,900); Enclave (5 sales, median $640,000); Ponderosa Station (4 sales); Westmoor (4 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom townhome in South Surrey?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom townhomes that sold in South Surrey was $425 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom townhomes in South Surrey compare
